sources.title: The Magnitude of Dominated Sets: A Pareto Compliant Indicator Grounded in Metric Geometry
sources.snippet: We investigate \emph{magnitude} as a new unary and strictly Pareto-compliant quality indicator for finite approximation sets to the Pareto front in multiobjective optimization. Magnitude originates in enriched category theory and metric geometry, where it is a notion of size or point content for compact metric spaces and a generalization of cardinality.
